description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ART/2022/FFRE78CR/SPLP Rev A, ART/2022/FFRE78CR/PL Rev A, ART/2021/FFRE78CR/PE Rev A, ART/2022/FFRE78CR/EL Rev A, ART/2022/FFRE78CR/EE Rev A, Supporting Statement, ART/2022/FFRE78CR/SPFP Rev A; received 20/05/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.
